title: Soilify
description: Makes everything into dirt. Mmmmm, dirt.
body:
Why complicate life when everything could just be… dirt? Dirtify Everything turns your entire Minecraft world into one massive, wholesome layer of dirt. Trees? Dirt. Houses? Dirt. Creepers? Yep… dirt.

CLIENT-SIDE ONLY FOR NOW! I PLAN ON ADDING SOME COOL STUFF LATER ON!
I may update this, I may not. Its a slop mod I made because I thought it would be funny.
